decisions.reason: Selecting the Business Case site list does not change the candidate's full-network opex basis or any of its current attributes; the separate opex clause already governs this Requirement.
The authoritative site list is owned by the source Requirement and does not change the candidate's capex input status, midpoint assumption basis, or site typologies.
The site-list selection does not alter the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
The authoritative site list does not change the debt/equity split, interest-rate assumption, tranche structure, or mezzanine policy.
Choosing the Business Case site list does not resolve or change the model currency, price-base year, or the separate CAD-versus-AUD ambiguity.
The site-list decision does not change the requirement to calculate equity IRR against the 16–20% target.
The authoritative site list does not change the required CCA treatment, example asset classes, tax-shield modeling, or equity-return effects.
The site-list selection does not alter the specified revenue streams or the requirement to model them separately.
The site-list decision does not change the DSCR and equity-IRR sizing targets or the prohibition on a negative-return DSCR-only approach.
The source decision does not change the requirement to retain the debt schedule and produce DSCR coverage analysis.
The authoritative site list does not modify the Case F and Case G definitions, their comparison, or the PPP availability-payment mechanism.
The site-list resolution supplies a model input but does not change the existing policy to use the supplied references and disclose provisional assumptions.
